questions.question:
b − 19 = (x)/(y)
The given equation relates the positive numbers b, x, and y. Which equation correctly expresses x in terms of b and y?
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by y: x = y(b − 19) = by − 19y.

questions.question:
f(x) = 12x + 6

The function gives the total number of people on a school trip with x teachers. What is the total number of people on a school trip with 12 teachers?
The function g is defined by g(x) = 2x − 148. For what value of x does g(x) = 76?
If 9(7 − 8x) + 2 = 8(7 − 8x) + 17, what is the value of 7 − 8x?
questions.explanation: Let t = 7 − 8x. Then 9t + 2 = 8t + 17, so t = 15.

questions.question:
7y = −6x + 2,170
24x − 28y = 1,400
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of x + y?
questions.explanation: Rewrite as 6x + 7y = 2,170 and 6x − 7y = 350 (dividing the second by 4). Adding gives 12x = 2,520, so x = 210 and y = 130, and x + y = 340.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = 30x. For what value of x is f(x) = 180?

y = 9x − 15
5x + y = 41
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of x + y?

49p = 49q − 49r − 49s
The given equation relates the positive variables p, q, r, and s. Which of the following is equivalent to q?
questions.explanation: Dividing by 49 and rearranging gives 1/q = 1/p + 1/r + 1/s = (rs + ps + pr)/(prs), so q = (prs)/(pr + ps + rs).

questions.question: Which expression is a factor of 3x2 + 57x + 15?
questions.explanation: Factoring gives 3x^2 + 57x + 15 = 3(x^2 + 19x + 5), so 3 is a factor.

questions.question: If (x + 2)<sup>2</sup> = 28, what is the value of x<sup>2</sup> + 4x?
The function h is defined by h(x) = 14(2)<sup>−x</sup> + 7. What is the value of h(3)?

The function f(x) = 236(1.022)<sup>x</sup> models the value, in dollars, of a certain bank account from 1958 through 1973, where x is the number of years after the end of 1958. Which of the following is the best interpretation of “f(5) is approximately equal to 263” in this context?
options: The value of the bank account is estimated to increase by approximately 263 dollars every 5 years between the end of 1958 and the end of 1973.
The value, in dollars, of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 5 times greater at the end of 1963 than at the end of 1958.
The value of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 5 dollars greater at the end of 1963 than at the end of 1958.
The value of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 263 dollars at the end of 1963.
questions.explanation: x = 5 is 5 years after the end of 1958, the end of 1963, and f(5) is the account’s value then.

questions.question: One of the factors of 4x<sup>3</sup> + 88x<sup>2</sup> + 468x is x + b, where b is a positive constant. What is the smallest possible value of b?
questions.explanation: 4x(x² + 22x + 117) = 4x(x + 9)(x + 13), so b can be 9 or 13; the smallest is 9.

questions.question: Each side of square A has a length of 24 inches. Each side of square A is multiplied by a scale factor of 2 to create square B. What is the length, in inches, of each side of square B?
questions.topic: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units

questions.question: After 20% of the original number of objects in a group were removed from the group, 180 objects remained in the group. How many objects were removed from the group?

Zuri has a goal to run at least 16 miles per week while training for a race. This week, she has run 4 miles. If x represents the additional number of miles Zuri needs to run this week to meet her goal, which inequality represents this situation?
questions.explanation: Total miles 4 + x must be at least 16, so 4 + x ≥ 16.

questions.question: The histogram shows the distribution of 20 lengths, in feet, in a data set. The first bar represents the lengths that are less than 50 feet, the second bar represents the lengths that are at least 50 feet but less than 100 feet, and so on. Which of the following could be the maximum length, in feet, in this data set?
questions.explanation: The last bar (200 to less than 250 feet) has a frequency of 5, so the maximum length lies in that interval. Only 219 is in it.

questions.question: For the positive quantities h, j, and k, 12% of h is equivalent to 95% of j, and j is equivalent to 24% of k. What percentage of k is h? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer. For example, if your answer is 39%, enter 39.)

(x + 3)2 + (y − 4)2 = 25
In the xy-plane, the graph of the given equation is a circle. Which point lies on this circle?
questions.explanation: For (√11 − 3, √14 + 4): (√11)² + (√14)² = 11 + 14 = 25, so it lies on the circle.

questions.question: A partially filled container containing 26 milliliters of water is placed under a leaky faucet that produces one 0.03-milliliter drop of water every 3 seconds. Until the container is full, which of the following can be used to represent the volume v, in milliliters, of water in the container t seconds after it is placed under the faucet, where t is a multiple of 3?
questions.explanation: The rate is 0.03 mL per 3 s = 0.01 mL/s, so v = 0.01t + 26.

questions.question:
(x − 5)2 + (y + 12)2 = 169

The given equation represents a circle. If the point (r, s) lies on the circle, which of the following could NOT be the point (r, s)?

In triangle XYZ, angle Y is a right angle, the measure of angle Z is 39°, and the length of YZ is 22 units. If the area, in square units, of triangle XYZ can be represented by the expression k tan 39°, where k is a constant, what is the value of k?
questions.explanation: XY = 22 tan 39°, so the area is (1/2)(22)(22 tan 39°) = 242 tan 39°.

questions.question: Line k is defined by y = 7x + 2. Line j is parallel to line k in the xy-plane and passes through the point (0, 3). Which equation defines line j?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have the same slope, 7, and the y-intercept is 3.

questions.question:
2y = 5x + 16
−2y = 7x − 22
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of 24x?
questions.explanation: Adding the equations gives 0 = 12x − 6, so x = 1/2 and 24x = 12.

questions.question: If a circuit consists of resistors connected in series, its resistance, in ohms, is equal to the sum of the resistances, in ohms, of all these resistors. A particular circuit consists of x identical resistors of type X and y identical resistors of type Y, which are connected in series. The resistance R, in ohms, of this circuit is given by the equation R = 13x + 15. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 13 in this context?
options: The total resistance of all resistors of type X in the circuit is 13 ohms.
The resistance of the circuit increases by 13 ohms with each addition of a resistor to the circuit.
The resistance of the circuit increases by 13x ohms with each addition of a resistor of type X to the circuit.
The resistance of the circuit increases by 13 ohms with each addition of a resistor of type X to the circuit.
questions.explanation: 13 is the coefficient of x (the number of type X resistors), so each added type X resistor raises R by 13 ohms.

questions.question:
x3 + 8(y − 16) = 27
x5 − 8(y − 16) = 45
The solution to the given system of equations is (x, y). What is the value of 8x?
questions.explanation: Adding the equations gives (8x)/(15) = 72, so x = 135 and 8x = 1080.

questions.question: For the linear function p, p(c) = −6, where c is a constant, p(5) = 42, and the slope of the graph of y = p(x) in the xy−plane is 8. For the linear function t, t(c) = −7 and t(6) = 56. What is the slope of the graph of y = t(x) in the xy−plane?

(x + k) + 92(y + t) + 19 = 0
(x + k) − 92(y + t) − 19 = 0
In the given system of equations, k and t are constants. The solution to this system is (x, y). What is the value of 18(y + t)?
questions.explanation: Subtracting the equations gives 9(y + t) + 38 = 0, so y + t = −38/9 and 18(y + t) = −76.

questions.question:
(x)/(5) + (y)/(9) = (47)/(45)
An engineer connects resistors in series, where the resistors in the series have a total resistance of 4745 ohms. In this series, there are x resistors of type A, which each have a resistance of a ohms, and y resistors of type B, which each have a resistance of b ohms. The given equation represents this situation. According to this equation, what is the positive difference between the value of a and the value of b?
questions.explanation: Total resistance is ax + by, so a = 1/5 and b = 1/9. The positive difference is 1/5 − 1/9 = 4/45.

questions.question:
y = 500(3)2x
The equation gives the estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of every six-month period, x, starting from the end of January 1992, where 0 ≤ x ≤ 4. Which statement is the best interpretation of the y-intercept of the graph of this equation in the xy-plane?
options: The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of the first six-month period was 500.
The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of January 1992 was 500.
The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of January 1993 was 1,500.
The estimated number of online newsletter subscribers at the end of January 1992 was 1,500.
questions.explanation: At x = 0, y = 500(3)^0 = 500, the count at the end of January 1992.

questions.question: f(x) = x<sup>2</sup> − 8x + 7. Which equivalent form shows the minimum value of f as a constant or coefficient?

f(x) = 5x2 + 60x + 181
The function g is defined by g(x) = f(x + 8). What is the minimum value of g(x)?
questions.explanation: Shifting horizontally doesn't change the minimum. f's vertex is at x = −6, where f(−6) = 180 − 360 + 181 = 1.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to (2x<sup>3</sup> − 3x + 5) − (7x<sup>6</sup> + 7x − 4)?
questions.explanation: Distribute the negative: 2x^3 − 3x + 5 − 7x^6 − 7x + 4 = −7x^6 + 2x^3 − 10x + 9.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = 3(14 − x)2 + 134. What is the value of f(14)?

The functions f and g are defined by the equations shown, where a and b are integer constants, a < b and b < 0. If y = f(x) and y = g(x) are graphed in the xy-plane, which of the following equations displays, as a constant or coefficient, the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the graph of the corresponding function?

I. f(x) = a(4.2)x+b
II. g(x) = a(4.2)x + b
questions.explanation: The y-intercept of f is a(4.2)^b and of g is a + b; neither of these is displayed as a constant or coefficient in the given forms.

questions.question: The positive number a is 2,047% of the sum of the positive numbers b and c, and b is 89% of c. What percent of b is a?
What is the approximate average rate of change of the amount, in millions of dollars per year, that the NFS granted to museums in Minnesota from 2000 to 2006?

f(x) = 3,950(0.38)<sup>x/12</sup>. The function f gives the value, in dollars, of a certain piece of equipment after x months of use. If the value of the equipment decreases each year by p% of its value the preceding year, what is the value of p?
questions.explanation: Each year (12 months) the value is multiplied by 0.38, so it decreases by 62%.

questions.question: A nutritionist wants to conduct a survey to estimate the mean number of servings of vegetables eaten by a certain group of people each day. The nutritionist has not yet decided which group of people to survey. Surveying a random sample from which of the following groups would most likely result in the smallest margin of error?
options: Viewers of the same television show
Students who are following the same daily diet plan
questions.topic: Inference from sample statistics and margin of error

questions.question: The length of the diagonal of a square is 188√22 units. What is the area, in square units, of the square?
questions.explanation: The diagonal is 94√(2), so the side is 94 and the area is 94^2 = 8,836.

questions.question: The width of a rectangle is 3 centimeters. The length of the rectangle is 20 centimeters longer than the width. What is the area, in square centimeters, of this rectangle?
questions.explanation: The length is 3 + 20 = 23 cm, so the area is 3 × 23 = 69 square centimeters.

questions.question:
For the first 10 hours of an experiment, the scatterplot shows the temperature y, in degrees Fahrenheit (°F), of an object at various times x, in hours, since the start of the experiment. A line of best fit is also shown.
Which of the following is the best interpretation of the slope of the line of best fit?
options: The predicted temperature decreases at a constant rate of approximately 190°F per hour over the 10-hour period.
The predicted temperature increases at a constant rate of approximately 190°F per hour over the 10-hour period.
The predicted temperature decreases at a constant rate of approximately 40°F per hour over the 10-hour period.
The predicted temperature increases at a constant rate of approximately 40°F per hour over the 10-hour period.
questions.explanation: The line rises from about 185°F at x = 0 to about 590°F at x = 10, a slope of about 40, so the predicted temperature increases about 40°F per hour.

questions.question: Circle K has a radius of 8 millimeters (mm). Circle L has an area of 144π mm2. What is the total area, in mm2, of circles K and L?
questions.explanation: Circle K has area π(8)^2 = 64π. Adding circle L gives 64π + 144π = 208π.

questions.question:
Circle A: (x − 7)2 + (y − p)2 = 21
Circle B: (x + 7)2 + (y − p)2 = 21
In the given equations, p is a positive constant. Which statement correctly compares the graphs of circles A and B in the xy−plane?
options: Circle B is the reflection of circle A across the x−axis.
Circle B is the reflection of circle A across the y−axis.
Circle B is the translation of circle A 14 units up.
Circle B is the translation of circle A 14 units to the right.
questions.explanation: Circle A has center (7, p) and circle B has center (−7, p), with equal radii. Mirroring across the y-axis sends (7, p) to (−7, p).
